title: Prospect AI conversation, buying-intent queue, and human handoff

evidence.browser: apps/retailer/e2e/prospect-ai-conversation.spec.ts is a cross-app journey (prospect submits via the customer storefront, staff triages/drafts/sends in the retailer app, customer sees the reply). It requires BOTH the customer (:3002) and retailer app servers running, but apps/retailer/playwright.config.ts starts only one app and the spec's RETAILER_APP_ORIGIN points at :3011 while the config serves :3001 (drift from commit 964d9db). The dual-app Playwright harness does not exist, so this journey has no runnable browser proof at rc HEAD — status implemented_unverified. The capability itself is built: domain (conversation-intent), migrations (20260806010000, 20260808170000), repositories, the customer storefront inquiry route, the retailer triage UI, and supabase/tests/conversation_ai_handoff_test.sql. Pre-existing (GROUND_TRUTH.md section 3); not caused by the V3-controller / global-sign-out integration.
evidence.live_gap: The deterministic local mock proves provider-neutral orchestration; live provider activation remains outside this local tranche without OPENAI_API_KEY.
